filing_office: West Virginia Secretary of State, Business and Licensing Division
filing_fee_notes: Base formation fee is 100; online filing adds 1. Qualifying applicants may receive formation-fee waivers. Online annual reports add 1 to the 25 base fee.
registered_agent_rules: The July 2026 formation form makes a separate agent for service of process optional. If designated, use an eligible West Virginia resident or qualifying business entity.
annual_report_due: June 30, beginning in the year after formation.
plain_english_summary: The base formation fee is 100 and the annual report costs 25. Online filings add a service charge.
common_mistake: Online filing charges are additional to the listed base fees.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC using the standard annual schedule. Eligible veteran-owned businesses can receive annual-report fee waivers. Filing URLs are official gateways. Name-search URL, processing time, expedited service, franchise or privilege tax, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
